fit: Uncentered SVD of 32 regular/fronted native context differences (unfronted minus fronted) and their positive small-dose normalized input responses. Save bases before intervention. Fit no outcomes.
identity: Context-switch response T(dc,e)=Down(Left(dc)*Right(e)+Left(e)*Right(dc)). Quadratic-in-e term cancels exactly.
design: Project context only, input response only, or both at ranks1/4/8. Full-context-switch and unchanged-context references. Five random rank1 context/input pairs, separately norm-matched to learned rank1 projected inputs. Test both signs/doses on regular/irregular fronted and relative-clause prompts.
scope: Actual context/input coefficients remain required. Irregular nouns and relative-clause rows are held out from basis fitting but previously explored. No novel corpus or learned coefficient generator. Rank1-both is one scalar-times-scalar output vector, not yet a semantic unit.
